name: SFC Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: SFC Holdings Co., Ltd. provides cross-border e-commerce retail, AI SaaS, and logistics solutions. It also offers services, such as import and export; develops and sells technical services of e-commerce software; supply chain management; warehousing and transportation, and freight forwarding. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China. SFC Holdings Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Shenzhen Ziwu Kangcheng Information Technology Co., Ltd.
